description: This file defines the ElseBlock class, which extends the Block class within the SCSSPHP library. It primarily sets the block type to T_ELSE during instantiation, indicating its role in representing an 'else' block in SCSS code.

classes.name: ElseBlock
classes.description: Represents an 'else' block in SCSS parsing, extending the base Block class and setting its type accordingly.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an ElseBlock instance by setting its type to T_ELSE.
